action: ONE cosme members: the operator says it will notify affected members; meanwhile change the password anywhere you reused it and be wary of unexpected messages to your email address.
date_note: Date of the operator's announcement as reported by ScanNetSecurity on 20 November; the access was found on 10 November.
exec: A Japanese beauty-review site may have lost data on up to 1,154 members, including encrypted passwords.
geo_basis: operator country (Japan); city not stated in the source
plain: The operator of the ONE cosme site said an outside party may have accessed it and obtained data on up to 1,154 members. About 1,150 password-reset emails were sent.
summary: According to ScanNetSecurity, IID, operator of ONE cosme, announced on 18 November that on 10 November it found a third party may have accessed the site through an overseas server and mechanically obtained member data. Up to 1,154 members' email addresses, birth dates, gender and encrypted passwords may have been taken. About 1,150 password-reset emails were sent.
title: ONE cosme operator says member data of up to 1,154 people may have been taken

validation.note: ScanNetSecurity article read, relaying the operator's notice; the operator's own notice was not read directly.

review.note: Source says third party 'may have' accessed; summary and plain now say so; action no longer implies an operator instruction. 1,154 'up to', data types, 10 and 18 Nov, about 1,150 reset emails match.
